entries.detail: Created isolated venv; initially installed older available packages, then aligned numpy2.5.2 pandas3.0.5 scipy1.18.0 sklearn1.9.0 before any candidate model fit. No candidate results were obtained with the initial versions.

First validator stopped before poison tests because its 1e-14 cost identity tolerance was tighter than immutable source-label rounding. Observed maximum residual4.989e-11. Validator tolerance corrected to1e-10 and records residual; no input, model, score, evaluation metric or output changed.

Independent read-only reviewer recomputed mean, win rate, worst day, worst decile and Top1/Top2 equal split for all3 periods/6 policies/3 slot groups with no discrepancy. Four local pytest tests passed. Test module uses unique evaluator import to avoid whole-repository pytest collisions.
